title: Jellyfish Pool Party
description: A vibrant nighttime pool party scene featuring a plus-size Black woman in a purple swimsuit and a bearded man in yellow patterned shorts dancing together in a pineapple-shaped pool filled with purple water. They are surrounded by glowing jellyfish, string lights, coconuts, and a squid, with a large pineapple structure in the background.
prompt: A lively cartoon illustration of a nighttime pool party inside a giant pineapple-shaped pool filled with glowing purple water. A happy plus-size Black woman with blonde hair wearing a purple floral swimsuit dances with a bearded man with curly hair in yellow patterned shorts. They are surrounded by many colorful glowing jellyfish of different sizes, string lights with purple and yellow bulbs, floating coconuts, and a friendly squid character. Bubbles and musical notes fill the dark background, creating a fun and whimsical party atmosphere.
